description: Crate tables do not carry every root id for the crate that owns the subject. REQ-SAG-0105, 0106 and 0108 are r-1 rows about sc-agent-types (backend descriptor, JevError variants, SubjectsDocument) and are absent from docs/sc-agent-types/requirements.md. The plan required only 0101, 0103, 0120, 0121 and NFR-0001 there, so this is a gap against the review brief, not against plan text. REQ-SAG-0606 (r-2b, equal from backend-reported digests) is absent from docs/sc-jev-check/requirements.md and from every other crate requirements doc. The same grep found 0606 only in the root table, architecture docs, sprint docs, code and boundary manifests. Add crate-level rows with an owning sprint and test reference: 0105, 0106 and 0108 in docs/sc-agent-types/requirements.md, and 0606 in docs/sc-jev-check/requirements.md. Alternatively record in each crate doc that the root table is authoritative for these ids. partially-compliant
